title: DeepBlend ScenePatch v1
description: A structured modification intent against one project revision (SPEC §8.3). A patch is never free-form: it carries the revision it was computed against, so a stale call can never silently overwrite newer work (SPEC §8.5, §9.4), and an idempotency key so a retried call can never apply twice. The key is DERIVED from the project, base revision and operations when the caller omits it, which makes an accidental retry safe by default; supply one explicitly only to re-apply the same operations on purpose.

baseRevision.description: The revision the caller read before computing this patch. A mismatch against currentRevision is rejected — no implicit overwrite.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen key identifying THIS logical intent. OPTIONAL: when omitted, one is derived from {projectId, baseRevision, actor, stage, operations}, so an identical retry returns the recorded outcome without re-applying anything, while a genuinely different patch still applies normally. Supply an explicit key only when you deliberately want the same operations to produce a new revision.

saveCheckpoint.description: Compile the patched spec and persist `<revision>/scene.blend` as the revision checkpoint. Required before a preview can be rendered from a checkpoint rather than a fresh compile (SPEC §9.1).

renderPreview.description: Also render the preview profile as part of the same commit, so the first revision of a project already has a viewable artifact.

actor.description: Who asked for the change, for the audit trail: a session id, a stage name such as `visual_review`, or an operator.

stage.description: Orchestrator stage that produced this patch (SPEC §12.1), recorded in operation-manifest.json.

note.description: Human-readable rationale, stored in the operation manifest so a revision history reads as prose.

world.description: The scene's environment illumination, replacing the whole block.

rotation.description: Rotation around world Z in radians; default zero.

transformPatch.description: Only the supplied components change; the rest of the transform is preserved.

anisotropic.description: Cycles Principled specular anisotropy. 0 disables; positive values need an explicit material tangent.

anisotropicRotation.description: Rotate the anisotropic tangent in turns: 0.25 is 90 degrees; 1 is one full turn. Nonzero values need an explicit tangent.

proceduralTexture.description: A procedural surface texture. Duplicated from scene-spec.schema.json because this schema is deliberately self-contained (it never $refs across files), so the two copies are kept in step by hand.

scale.description: Pattern density in the selected coordinate space. Larger is finer; UV density is relative to the UV layout.

coordinates.description: Coordinate source. Omitted means object space. UV uses the named UV map or the active render UV map on each used surface.

scale.description: Pattern density in the selected coordinate space. Larger is finer; UV density is relative to the UV layout.

coordinates.description: Coordinate source. Omitted means object space. UV uses the named UV map or the active render UV map on each used surface.

uvMap.description: Existing UV map name. Requires coordinates: uv. Omit to use the active render UV map.

profile.description: Lathe boundary in ordered [radius, height] points, in scene units. Radius must be nonnegative. Do not repeat the first point to close it.

closedProfile.description: Join the final profile point to the first, for annular or hollow sections. Default false.

capEnds.description: Close open lathe rings or curve ends. Default true; closed paths and profiles need no caps.

path.description: Ordered local-space points for a swept round section.

pathClosed.description: Connect the last path point to the first. Default false.

pathInterpolation.description: poly preserves straight segments; bezier uses automatic smooth handles. Default poly.

rootTension.description: Dimensionless scale of both endpoint tangent speeds for the quintic attachment. Missing or 1 preserves the original surface; 1.5 spreads the transition. Native output validation still applies.

generator.description: Deterministic procedural geometry. Lathe revolves a radius/height profile; handled_cup constructs a closed cup with shared-boundary flared handle roots. Coupled parameter constraints are checked before generation and the discrete output is validated.

modifiers.description: Ordered mesh operations, applied before animation and simulation. Boolean dependencies compile before their consumers. Each participating entity must contain exactly one mesh.

materialBindings.description: Asset mesh part overrides, preserving original slots and face indices. Part-wide overrides precede slot-specific overrides.

role.description: What this camera is FOR in a multi-view preview. The view plan assigns roles by this field; without it a camera has no role and the plan can only fall back to camera id order, which is not an author statement about anything.

targetKind.description: What `targetEntityId` names: an entity (default), a camera, or a material. Only entity tracks existed before, which is why "the camera orbits the product" and "the dial lights up" both had to be faked with entity transforms.

targetEntityId.description: The id of the target named by `targetKind`. The field name says Entity because every track written before target kinds existed used it and revisions are immutable; renaming it would make r0001-r0023 unreadable. Resolution is against the collection `targetKind` names, which matters because ids are unique per collection, not globally.

property.description: The channel to animate. Transform channels apply to entities and cameras; material parameters apply to materials and use the same names `material.parameter.update` takes.

tags.description: The entity's complete tag list, replacing whatever it had. Tags are how a scene states intent that geometry cannot: "environment" excludes backdrop from occlusion tracking, "hero-product" marks the subject, and "subject-part" says this entity is part of the subject's own body rather than something standing in front of it. An empty array removes the tags key entirely.

role.description: What this camera is FOR in a multi-view preview (see the scene-spec schema).

path.description: Project-relative POSIX path, exactly as blender_asset_ingest reports it. Absolute paths and any ".." segment are rejected by the path guard (SPEC §15.2).

miterInner.description: Inner corner join for this bevel modifier. Omitted values preserve the existing arc behavior.

partId.description: Exact source path returned in assetParts; JSON Pointer escaped segments.

slotIndex.description: Original material slot index. Omit to replace every slot of this mesh part.

oneOf.description: Use the tangent along the named UV map U direction. The map must exist on every mesh face using this material.
Blender cylindrical-projection tangent around the selected object-local axis; no UV map required.

purposes.description: Distinct review dimensions this reference informs; duplicate purposes are rejected semantically.

referenceImages.description: Visual review references only. Each id is unique and points to a declared, hash-pinned PNG/JPEG project asset; this does not apply an object texture or environment map.
